title: Aerial View of Motorboat off Rocky Coastline, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A high-angle or aerial black-and-white snapshot showing a shoreline where dark underwater formations, possibly reefs, rocks, or submerged vegetation, extend out into the water from the sandy edge. A single small motorboat navigates through the calmer, deeper water just off the reef area. The print features a classic mid-century scalloped deckle edge.
